review_verdict: M158 r2 fully repairs the r1 signed-mask error and independently reproduces the frozen weight bound. It establishes an Acc19 mathematical candidate only under an exact-once, zero-init, raw-Conv coefficient contract. It does not yet admit source-major integrated reorder exactness or deletion of the runtime overflow tree from RTL.

findings.title: Runtime overflow tree removal precedes an integrated exact-once coefficient proof
findings.evidence: The sum(abs) theorem requires every feature prefix coefficient to remain in [-1,1]. M115r2 still marks integrated_accepted_transaction_exact_once_miter=false and signed19_accumulator_rtl=false. A duplicate accepted feature transaction permits coefficient magnitude 2 and raises the conservative bound to 436676, above Acc19 and requiring signed20.
findings.impact: The r2 fields source_major_integer_reorder_exactness=true and runtime_overflow_detector_required_for_frozen_domain=false are not hardware-admissible yet. Stalls, reset replay, stale responses or cache aliasing could invalidate the mathematical coefficient bound.
findings.required_action: Before deleting the tree, run VCS/SVA on the integrated source-major cache/PWP/correction/Acc19 path with an accepted-transaction exact-once coefficient miter and duplicate/stale/reset/cache-alias attacks. Outside that sealed path, retain the guard or use at least signed20 fallback.

findings.title: The contract's 'each feature contributes at most once' wording is not the actual PWP condition
findings.evidence: For center=1,target=0 the same feature produces a +1 PWP anchor and a -1 correction: two delivered operations. Exhaustive legal order enumeration still bounds its prefix coefficient at magnitude one, but literal occurrence count is two.
findings.impact: An implementation could satisfy the prose poorly or reject a legal stream while missing the real safety invariant.
findings.required_action: Replace the occurrence rule with: for every output accumulator and convolution feature, the accepted prefix coefficient must remain in [-1,1], with each required anchor/correction accepted exactly once. Pin M108/M115r2 or restate and re-prove this invariant in the integrated r2 lineage.

findings.title: Bias is closed, but BN/scale/residual fusion boundary is not
findings.evidence: All four audited Conv2d payloads are bias-free and zero-initialized, so bias is not missing. M41 explicitly has dynamic_no_running_batchnorm_admitted=false and runtime_scale_application_admitted=false; M158 does not prove that BN affine, residual, requantization or late-scale terms remain outside Acc19.
findings.impact: Fusing any unbounded affine/residual term into the same accumulator invalidates the 218338 raw-weight bound.
findings.required_action: Make raw Conv accumulation a typed RTL boundary with zero-init assertions and separate post-accumulator BN/scale/residual interfaces, or add every fused term to the bound.

findings.title: Frozen-domain identity and fallback are documentary, not enforced
findings.evidence: The proof pins exact SHA files, but no RTL/build/boot mechanism binds the accumulator configuration to those payloads, Acc19 width and zero-bias operator identity. The contract says untrusted inputs require fail closed without implementing that transition.
findings.impact: A different checkpoint, weight corruption or alternate operator can silently execute without the protection that was removed.
findings.required_action: Use immutable compiled payload identity or a boot-time authenticated manifest/config check; fail closed to a wider/guarded path for any identity mismatch.

findings.title: Destination-half evidence is data-level, not an RTL transaction miter
findings.evidence: The reviewer independently reconstructs every destination event/sign low/high half with zero mismatch and freezes digest dac2e8f4..., but M158 still reports rtl_trace_miter=false.
findings.impact: The software tuple transform is exact; ready/valid ordering, tag identity and accepted output behavior remain unproved.
findings.required_action: Replay a bounded exact-SHA sample through VCS and compare accepted RTL half transactions to the frozen digest/order oracle under backpressure.

findings.title: The numeric domain is Motion/H67 heldout only
findings.evidence: The replay covers sample IDs 5..9 for four H67/Motion ep35 Conv3x3 operators. Local5 and other checkpoints/quantizations are outside the proof.
findings.impact: The result is checkpoint-specific hardware specialization evidence, not a general Acc19 guarantee.
findings.required_action: Keep the exact checkpoint scope in every claim; independently recompute bounds for any added model/checkpoint and route failures to the guarded/wider path.

promotion_gate: signed19 accumulator RTL and RTL trace miter
guarded or signed20 fallback outside the sealed domain

headline_boundary.allowed: A fresh independent replay of 20 frozen H67/Motion heldout records reconstructs 188148490 signed events, including 17557357 negative events, with exact destination-half splitting. Under an exact-once zero-bias raw-Conv coefficient contract, four frozen INT8 payloads have a maximum per-channel sum(abs) of 218338, making Acc19 a mathematical candidate.
forbidden: M158 proves integrated source-major RTL reorder exactness
the 384-lane runtime overflow tree can now be removed
every feature is delivered at most once under PWP decomposition
Acc19 is safe for BN/residual/late-scale fusion
physical, system, PPA or headline speedup
